commit 20a4b7285d86124ac68b58fa464fb74c5d62cc82
Author:     welpy-cw <h.w.forms@arcor.de>
AuthorDate: Sun Mar 1 12:51:29 2026 +0200
Commit:     welpy-cw <h.w.forms@arcor.de>
CommitDate: Sun Mar 1 12:51:29 2026 +0200

    Bug 2012697 - Migrate Filter Editor dialog and search widgets to Fluent. r=coreyb,mkmelin
    
    
    This patch completes the localization migration for filter-related legacy
    files. Messages belonging to search widgets are consolidated into
    searchWidgets.ftl, and the minus symbol for removal buttons is unified
    across the filter and search interfaces.
    
    To prevent global scope collisions in windows that load multiple search-related
    scripts (such as the Filter List and Virtual Folder dialogs), the localization
    handle in searchWidgets.js is renamed to searchWidgetsL10n, ensuring it does
    not overwrite the window-level l10n handles of the parent dialogs.
    
    Summary of changes:
    - Finalizes migration of FilterEditor.dtd and filter.properties.
    - Moves shared search widget strings to searchWidgets.ftl.
    - Unifies the minus symbol (U+2212) on rule and action buttons.
    - Renames l10n handles in shared scripts to avoid window-level collisions.
    - Updates FilterEditor.js/xhtml and searchWidgets.js to use Fluent.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D282317
